dispositions.rationale: Fixed for HOME: the LLM now runs with a scratch HOME/XDG and an empty GH_CONFIG_DIR containing only explicitly allowlisted LLM-CLI login files (never .config/gh or .ssh), tested. The remaining exposure is an OS credential store (macOS Keychain) reachable by any same-user process; hiding it needs an OS sandbox that is outside this change. It is documented as residual risk with hosted, credential-free workers recommended for untrusted content; publication authority stays bounded by the harness-only, validated, expected-head-leased push.

The approved BR-353 decomposition (ADD intents and their dependency chain) assigns publication of review/repair jobs to pr-review-repair-gate, finalize to post-review-finalization, and integration-repair, retrospective, terminal-reconciliation and cleanup to autonomous-integration-contour, whose delta explicitly requires post-handoff obligations as jobs. This child is their prerequisite and delivers the job/claim/worker contract plus the coordinator entrypoint publish_job those children call; wiring every transition here would implement their scope ahead of their contracts. The integration marker is the coordinator's own claim, not a worker job.
